Name: Better Doors
Author: CatCattyCat
Description:
[size=6]Better Doors[/size][size=6]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rSl5hzd.gif[/img]

[/size][size=4]This mod lets map makers easily add doors with cool features to their maps. It [b]doesn't do anything by itself[/b] but may be required by a map mod. [size=4]In multiplayer, every player needs to have the same map mod, Better Doors content packs, and Better Doors installed![/size]
[size=6][size=4][b][size=5]
[size=6]Cool features:[/size][/size][/b]
[/size][/size][/size][list]
[*][size=4]Automatic doors: Have doors automatically open and close when you walk past them![/size]
[*][size=4]Double doors: Place two doors next to each other and have both of them open when one does![/size]
[*][size=4]Horizontal doors: Have doors that can be put in horizontal hallways as opposed to SDV's vertical only doors![/size]
[*][size=4]Vanilla + custom door textures: don't be limited by just SDV's door sprites![/size]
[/list]
[size=6][b]For users who want to edit config options:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=4][b]DoorToggleRadius[/b] (default 2). This is how close you need to be to doors before you can open them. Set to any positive number. If you want it bigger try 3 or 4.[/size]
[*][size=4][b]MakeAllDoorsAutomatic[/b] (default false). If you set this to true, all doors will be automatic regardless of what settings the map maker used.[/size]
[*][size=4][b]SilenceAutomaticDoors[/b] (default false). If you set this to true, automatic doors will silently open and close. However, manual door opening/closings will still make sound.[/size]
[/list][list]
[/list][size=4][size=6][b]For map modders who want to add better doors to their maps:[/b][/size][/size][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][size=4]If you're a map modder, you add some custom tile properties to the tiles where you want doors. See the modder documentation for more info![/size]
[*][size=4]If you're a sprite artist, you can provide custom door textures for map modders to use. [size=4]See the modder documentation for more info![/size][/size]
[/list][b][size=5][url=https://github.com/danvolchek/StardewMods/wiki/Better-Doors]Click here to see the modder documentation.[/url]﻿[/size][/b][size=4]

Requires SMAPI by Pathoschild.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files][size=5]Check out my other mods by clicking here![/size][/url][/size]
